Stollen 1930 in Kufstein

** Discover the timeless tradition of **Stollen** in the charming town of **Kufstein**, where this beloved Christmas treat has been crafted since **1930**. Step into **Stollen 1930**, a cozy bakery with a rich heritage, and indulge in the warm, buttery aroma of freshly baked **Stollen**—a symbol of the festive season in **Tirol**. Our master bakers follow age-old recipes, blending spices, dried fruits, and marzipan into the perfect loaf. Whether you prefer the classic **Kaiserschmarrn**-flavored **Stollen** or a delicate **Vanille-Stollen**, each piece is a taste of **Tirol’s** holiday magic. Visit us in the heart of **Kufstein**, where tradition meets modern craftsmanship. Experience the warmth of **Tirol’s** Christmas culture—one bite at a time.
